CustomField.formula:
IF( TEXT(Type__c) = "BE TIS",
TEXT(YEAR(NAV_Date__c)) & "-" & LPAD(TEXT(MONTH(NAV_Date__c)), 2, "0") & "-" & LPAD(TEXT(DAY(NAV_Date__c)), 2, "0"),
IF( OR( TEXT(Type__c) = "Transparency", TEXT(Type__c) = "BE Asset Test", TEXT(Type__c) = "Belgium Simulator" ),
TEXT(YEAR(StartDate__c)) & "-" & LPAD(TEXT(MONTH(StartDate__c)), 2, "0") & "-" & LPAD(TEXT(DAY(StartDate__c)), 2, "0")
& " → " &
TEXT(YEAR(EndDate__c)) & "-" & LPAD(TEXT(MONTH(EndDate__c)), 2, "0") & "-" & LPAD(TEXT(DAY(EndDate__c)), 2, "0"),
"" ) )
